QUOTE: `LlamaCppBackend::tokenize` (`llama_cpp_backend.cpp:788-800`) returns `{}` if `tokenizer_` is unset, and otherwise passes the seam's result through. There is no status code, so the empty vector is the only signal.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the failed tokenization yields `{}` (empty vector) and that the backend wrapper also returns `{}` when no tokenizer is wired. It notes the empty vector is the only signal, so the two cases are indistinguishable.
